resources.string: You usually won\'t need it: if you still have a device or a family member with KidBox, you can get back in from there.
Save it now: you\'ll only see it this once. It works for all your families and on every device.
If you lose this code and all your devices, and no family member has the app, encrypted data can\'t be recovered.
Print it or save it in your phone\'s password manager. Don\'t save it in KidBox Passwords: they open with the same key this code is meant to recover.
Type the characters of the code at the positions shown.
That doesn\'t match: check the code you saved.
Your vault was just created on another device: open it with that code.
Invalid code: make sure you typed all of it correctly.
Lost your code? If you still have a device or a family member with KidBox, you can get back in from there.
Your family\'s key is protected. Not even KidBox can open it.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
KidBox documents, passwords and photos are encrypted with a key only your family has. To get it back on a new phone or computer, save a recovery code. Not even KidBox can open it.
You only need to do this once on this device: type the recovery code you saved.
Save the key in your Google backup

Turn on Google Backup on this phone: if you reinstall KidBox or switch phones, your family\'s key comes back on its own, encrypted with your screen lock so not even Google can read it. Without it, you\'ll need your recovery code.
Can\'t read the status. Check your connection.
Vault not yet opened on this device
Documents, passwords and photos are encrypted with a key only your family has. Here you choose how to get it back on a new device. Not even KidBox can open it.
Open the vault on this device
If you\'ve lost your code but still have this device, create a new one: the old one stops working.
The previous code no longer works: from now on use the new one.
Open it with your fingerprint or screen lock too?
Create a passkey: on another device with the same Google account, unlocking will be enough, no code to type. Your code stays valid.
This phone can\'t use a passkey for the vault: your recovery code remains your key.
This passkey doesn\'t work here. Use your recovery code.
To give the key to your computer (“Sign in with your phone”), to a new device of yours, or to a family member who doesn\'t have it.
Scan the QR code shown by the computer, another device of yours, or a family member\'s phone.
That device will be able to open the encrypted data of all your families. Confirm only if the QR code is on your computer or one of your devices.
This lets them read the family\'s documents, passwords and photos even without the key.
The other device receives it sealed and opens it itself: not even KidBox can read it.
This isn\'t a KidBox key QR code.
The QR code has expired or was already used: ask for a new one.
There\'s no key to send from here to whoever is showing the QR code: it must be your account or a member of your family.
Scanning the QR code needs the camera: allow it in your phone settings.
On another device of yours with KidBox open Settings › Security › “Scan a QR code”. A family member can do it from their phone too. The key arrives sealed: not even KidBox can open it.
The key that arrived can\'t be opened. Try again with a new code.
Family key received from a family member.
